_comment: Declared provider list prices. ALL dollar figures in Autopilot resolve against this file — no figure is ever invented at runtime. The harness itself costs $0 to run (the chaos proxy stands in for a real provider), so these are a MODEL of cost, applied to real measured token counts. This is stated plainly in the README and docs/benchmark.md; see docs/architecture.md Q4 on why token counts are themselves estimated from character length on this build.

autopilot-canned._note: The chaos proxy's deterministic stand-in model. Priced as a cheap small model so budget arithmetic is realistic.

autopilot-canned-mid._note: Stand-in for the mid tier, used by model_escalation.

autopilot-canned-strong._note: Stand-in for the strong tier, used by model_escalation.

latencyMs._note: Declared typical latencies per strategy, used for budget feasibility BEFORE execution. Actual measured latency is recorded separately in traces.

successPriors._note: Declared, not learned. The plan explicitly rules out a learned ranker for v1 — these are honest static priors, stated as such.
